# Libraries 
```{r load libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(cowplot)
library(ggpubr)
library(ggh4x)
library(flextable)
library(rempsyc)
```

# Import data
```{r DEG counts}
#34
DEGs_34 <- read.delim("data/Sequencing/Porites_astreoides/DESeq_rev2/Reviewer-Code-Run/34/rev2_34C_interaction_classification_all_timepoints.txt") %>%
  mutate(Temp = 34)

DEG_counts_34 <- read.delim("data/Sequencing/Porites_astreoides/DESeq_rev2/Reviewer-Code-Run/34/rev2_34C_interaction_category_counts.txt") %>%
  mutate(Temp = 34)

#37
DEGs_37 <- read.delim("data/Sequencing/Porites_astreoides/DESeq_rev2/Reviewer-Code-Run/37/rev2_37C_interaction_classification_all_timepoints.txt") %>%
  mutate(Temp = 37)

DEG_counts_37 <- read.delim("data/Sequencing/Porites_astreoides/DESeq_rev2/Reviewer-Code-Run/37/rev2_37C_interaction_category_counts.txt") %>%
  mutate(Temp = 37)

#39
DEGs_39 <- read.delim("data/Sequencing/Porites_astreoides/DESeq_rev2/Reviewer-Code-Run/39/rev2_39C_interaction_classification_all_timepoints.txt") %>%
  mutate(Temp = 39)

DEG_counts_39 <- read.delim("data/Sequencing/Porites_astreoides/DESeq_rev2/Reviewer-Code-Run/39/rev2_39C_interaction_category_counts.txt") %>%

```

# Combine DEG Counts
```{r}
DEGs_all <- rbind(DEGs_34, DEGs_37, DEGs_39)

DEG_counts_all <- rbind(DEG_counts_34, DEG_counts_37, DEG_counts_39)
```

# Count Genes
```{r}
length(unique(DEGs_all$Gene))

DEGs_sam_dir <- DEGs_all %>%
  filter(grepl("Same direction", Category))

length(unique(DEGs_sam_dir$Gene))

DEGs_opp_dir <- DEGs_all %>%
  filter(grepl("Opposite direction", Category))

length(unique(DEGs_opp_dir$Gene))

DEGs_one_dir <- DEGs_all %>%
  filter(grepl("only", Category))

length(unique(DEGs_one_dir$Gene))
```

```{r}
DEGs_all_df <- DEGs_all %>%
  mutate(
    Category_Direction = case_when(
      
      # Opposite-direction responses
      Category == "Opposite direction" & abs(Offshore_LFC) > abs(Inshore_LFC) ~
      "Opposite direction, Stronger Offshore",
      
      Category == "Opposite direction" & abs(Inshore_LFC) > abs(Offshore_LFC) ~
      "Opposite direction, Stronger Inshore",

      # Population-specific responses
      Category == "Offshore only" ~ "Opposite direction, Stronger Offshore",
      Category == "Inshore only" ~ "Opposite direction, Stronger Inshore",

      # Keep same-direction categories unchanged
      TRUE ~ Category)) %>%
  mutate(
    Direction = case_when(
      grepl("Opposite direction", Category_Direction) ~ "Opposite direction",
      grepl("Same direction", Category_Direction) ~ "Same direction",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_),
    Stronger_Population = case_when(
      grepl("Offshore", Category_Direction, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Offshore",
      grepl("Inshore", Category_Direction, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Inshore",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_)) %>%
  select(Gene, Temp, Timepoint, Interaction_LFC, Offshore_LFC, Inshore_LFC, Category, Direction, Category_Direction, Stronger_Population)
```

# Fig 4a: Plot DEGs by # with stronger magnitude 
```{r}
Summary_counts_population <- DEGs_all_df %>%
  group_by(Temp, Timepoint, Stronger_Population) %>%
  summarise(Total_DEGs = n_distinct(Gene), .groups = "drop")

# Create labels and colors for Temp Treatments 
custom_labels_temp <- c("34" = "34°C", "37" = "37°C", "39" = "39°C", 
                        "TF" = "TF")

Temp_color <- c("34" = "#FFDD44", "37" = "#FF9933", "39" = "#DB2F0D")


Fig_4a <- ggplot(Summary_counts_population, 
       aes(x = Timepoint, y = Total_DEGs, 
           fill = Stronger_Population)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c('#8ADCE3', "#003A9D"),
                    labels = c("Stronger Inshore", "Stronger Offshore")) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0), limits = c(0,3000)) +
  facet_wrap2(~Temp, 
    labeller = labeller(Temp = custom_labels_temp),
    strip = strip_themed(
      background_x = elem_list_rect(fill = Temp_color))) +
  theme_bw() +
  ylab("# of DEGs") +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent"),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 11),
    panel.spacing.x = unit(0.1, "lines"),
    panel.spacing.y = unit(0.1, "lines"),
    legend.margin = margin(t = -5, b = 0, unit = "pt"),  
    plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 10, b = 10, l = 10))

ggsave(
  filename = "Plots/Fig_4/Fig_4a_magnitude.pdf",  # Name of the output file
  plot = Fig_4a,               # Specify the plot to save
  width = 7,                       # Width in inches
  height = 3                        # Height in inches
)

ggsave(
  filename = "Plots/Fig_4/Fig_4a_magnitude.png",  # Name of the output file
  plot = Fig_4a,               # Specify the plot to save
  width = 7,                       # Width in inches
  height = 3                        # Height in inches
)
```

# Fig 4B: DEG Overlap
```{r}
DEGs_all_venn <- DEGs_all_df %>%
  dplyr::select(Gene, Timepoint, Temp, Category) %>%
  mutate(
    Population = case_when(
      grepl("direction", Category) ~ "Both",
      grepl("Inshore only", Category) ~ "Inshore Specific",
      grepl("Offshore only", Category) ~ "Offshore Specific")) %>%
  group_by(Timepoint, Temp, Population) %>%
  summarise(n = n_distinct(Gene), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Timepoint, Temp) %>%
  mutate(Percentage = n / sum(n) * 100) %>%
  ungroup()  %>% 
  mutate(
    Population = factor(
      Population,
      levels = c( "Inshore Specific","Both",  "Offshore Specific")))


Fig_4b <- ggplot(DEGs_all_venn, aes(x = Timepoint, y = Percentage, fill = Population)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "fill") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_fill_manual(name = "", values=c('#8ADCE3',"#458BC0","#003A9D")) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  facet_wrap2(~Temp, 
             labeller = labeller(Temp = custom_labels_temp),
             strip = strip_themed(background_x = elem_list_rect(fill = Temp_color))) +
  labs(y = "Proportion of DEGs", x = "", fill = "") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position="bottom",
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent"),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 11),
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 11),
        panel.spacing.x = unit(0.1, "lines"),
        panel.spacing.y = unit(0.1, "lines"),
        legend.margin = margin(t = -5, b = 0, unit = "pt"),  
        plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 10, b = 10, l = 10))

ggsave(
  filename = "Plots/Fig_4/Fig_4b.pdf",  # Name of the output file
  plot = Fig_4b,               # Specify the plot to save
  width = 8,                       # Width in inches
  height = 4                        # Height in inches
)

ggsave(
  filename = "Plots/Fig_4/Fig_4b.png",   # Name of the output file
  plot = Fig_4b,               # Specify the plot to save
  width = 8,                       # Width in inches
  height = 4                        # Height in inches
)

```

# Fig S3: DEG directions
```{r Fig S3a same}
DEGs_all_df_direction_same <-  DEGs_all_df %>% 
  select(Gene, Timepoint, Temp, Offshore_LFC, Inshore_LFC, Direction) %>%
  filter(Direction == "Same direction") %>%
 mutate(Regulated = case_when(Offshore_LFC > 0 & Inshore_LFC > 0 ~ "Upregulated",
                              Offshore_LFC < 0 & Inshore_LFC < 0 ~ "Downregulated",
                              TRUE ~ NA_character_)) %>%
  group_by(Direction, Temp,  Timepoint, Regulated) %>%
  summarise(n = n_distinct(Gene), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Population = "Both Populations")
  
Fig_S3a <- ggplot(DEGs_all_df_direction_same, aes(x = Timepoint, y = n, fill = Regulated)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("gray60", "gray30")) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0), limits = c(0,3000)) +
     facet_grid2(Population~Temp, 
    labeller = labeller(Temp = custom_labels_temp),
    strip = strip_themed(
      background_x = elem_list_rect(fill = Temp_color))) +
    theme_bw() +
  ylab("# of DEGs") +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent"),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 11),
    panel.spacing.x = unit(0.1, "lines"),
    panel.spacing.y = unit(0.1, "lines"))
  
ggsave(
  filename = "Plots/Supplemental_Figs/Fig_S3a.png", 
  plot = Fig_S3a,               
  width = 7,                       # Width in inches
  height = 3                        # Height in inches
)


```

```{r Fig S3b opposite}
DEGs_all_df_direction_opp <-  DEGs_all_df %>% 
  select(Gene, Timepoint, Temp, Offshore_LFC, Inshore_LFC, Direction) %>%
  filter(Direction == "Opposite direction") %>%
 mutate(Offshore = case_when(Offshore_LFC > 0  ~ "Upregulated",
                             Offshore_LFC < 0 ~ "Downregulated",
                             Offshore_LFC == 0 ~ "Not Present")) %>%
  mutate(Inshore = case_when(Inshore_LFC > 0  ~ "Upregulated",
                             Inshore_LFC < 0 ~ "Downregulated",
                             Inshore_LFC == 0 ~ "Not Present")) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Offshore, Inshore), names_to = "Population",
               values_to = "Regulation") %>%
  group_by(Timepoint, Temp, Population, Regulation) %>%
  summarise(n = n_distinct(Gene), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(Regulation != "Not Present") %>%
  filter(Population == "Offshore")
  
Fig_S3b <- ggplot(DEGs_all_df_direction_opp, aes(x = Timepoint,  y = n, fill = Regulation)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "Identity", position = "stack") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("gray60", "gray30")) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0), limits = c(0,3000)) +
     facet_grid2(Population~Temp, 
    labeller = labeller(Temp = custom_labels_temp),
    strip = strip_themed(background_x = elem_list_rect(fill = Temp_color),
                         background_y = elem_list_rect(fill = "#003A9D"),
                         text_y = element_text(color = "white"))) +
    theme_bw() +
  ylab("# of DEGs") +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent"),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 11),
    panel.spacing.x = unit(0.1, "lines"),
    panel.spacing.y = unit(0.1, "lines"))

ggsave(
  filename = "Plots/Supplemental_Figs/Fig_S3b.png", 
  plot = Fig_S3b,               
  width = 5,                       # Width in inches
  height = 7                        # Height in inches
)
```
